usage: The word '杯' (bui1) is a noun that refers to a cup or glass used for drinking.
It can be used to talk about any type of drinking vessel, such as a tea cup, coffee cup, or water glass.
When counting cups, you can use measure words like '隻' (zek3) or '個' (go3), depending on the context and type of cup.
It is common to use '一杯' (jat1 bui1) to mean 'a cup of' followed by a drink, e.g. '一杯水' means 'a cup of water'.
